title: Correct Android build logging before APK verification
summary: The first build produced a build-15 APK and seven passing native tests, but the PowerShell wrapper treated an Expo environment warning as an error and did not capture completion.

changes.detail: Set NODE_ENV=production and use the actual Gradle exit status instead of treating every stderr warning as a terminating PowerShell error. Preserve the original log and retry with a separate final log.
Document behavior, platform limits and physical-device acceptance steps.

validation.name: Initial build wrapper
validation.detail: PowerShell returned exit 1 on the missing NODE_ENV warning. APK metadata says build 15, but completion was not captured; do not infer build success from this wrapper result.

validation.name: Native server tests
validation.detail: JUnit XML reports seven tests, zero failures/errors, including day-long approved inactivity, stop revocation and unapproved request expiry.

validation.name: Viewer and history tests, typecheck and lint
validation.detail: 15 focused tests, TypeScript and focused ESLint passed.

validation.name: Build retry and APK validation
validation.detail: Retry running. Physical two-phone acceptance remains untested; no deployment.
